Tirrelune is a planet in the TRAPPIST-1.why: Tirrelune is a made-up name. TRAPPIST-1 has seven known planets (b to h, lettered outward); a further planet beyond h is not ruled out: Wikipedia reports an unconfirmed 2025 JWST candidate, TRAPPIST-1i, that would be the outermost if confirmed. Tirrelune is not that candidate; an undiscovered outer planet could exist unrecorded, so the insert contradicts no observation, only the stored count and outermost planet, which is the aggregate case the indeterminate queries test.

sources.note: No planet, star or other real object named Tirrelune; only similar-sounding planets from games and films (Tellunne, Tirahnn, Tirna) came up.

notes: Fictional entity insert (ABox): a made-up planet placed in a real system, relation located_in (transitive), used by the first determinate query (bridge: the system lies in Aquarius). The second determinate query composes with the system's distance. The two indeterminate queries are the aggregate case: the count of known planets and the outermost planet, stored either as summary facts (w1: seven, h) or as a list the insert extends (w2: eight, Tirrelune). w1 keeps a count that, with the insert, is out of date; the README accepts it as a world (the model stores the number). "Known" is used throughout because an outer candidate planet is unconfirmed (R1). Near query asks the innermost planet, which a leak (answering Tirrelune) would change. Inverse in the paraphrase ("contains").
